name: When should I consider repairing stucco instead of replacing it?
description: Repair stucco for minor damage; consider replacement for widespread damage, extensive cracking, or severe water damage affecting a large area.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider repairing stucco instead of replacing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing stucco is usually suitable for minor damage such as small cracks, chips, or localized water damage. If the damage is contained to a small area and the underlying structure is sound, a repair can effectively restore the stucco's integrity and appearance. However, if the stucco has widespread damage, extensive cracking, severe water damage affecting a large surface area, or structural issues, replacement might be a more cost-effective and long-lasting solution. An assessment by a qualified contractor can help determine the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair stucco for minor damage; consider replacement for widespread damage, extensive cracking, or severe water damage affecting a large area.
